chapters.reason: The paper investigates the computational capabilities and internal structure of neural networks trained on group operations, aiming for a unified and verified explanation, which aligns with theoretical proofs of computational capabilities.
The paper analyzes the internals of one-hidden-layer networks, revealing distinct computational roles and structure, which corresponds to micro-level observation of layer functions in reasoning.

The study focuses on reverse-engineering the computation performed by networks, identifying specialized structure and equivariance, which relates to the core of latent reasoning and specialized sub-circuits.
